overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a generic "Superintendent's report" notice item was adequate because the chair did not anticipate the topics. The Committee voluntarily committed to more detailed notices going forward.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the 'Superintendent's report' agenda item was too vague to inform the public of the substantive discussion at the February 11 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: As the Chair was not aware of what the Superintendent intended to report to the Committee ahead of the meeting, the Committee was not required to include more detail on its meeting notice.
